_provenance: 18 of 22 definitions and all 22 grammar notes were written by hub, approved by Kymber but not independently verified. Per-entry in 'hub_added'.

א.name: Aleph
א.definition: First letter of the Hebrew alphabet, numeric value 1. The ancient form depicts an ox head. Not a vowel — it carries a glottal stop, the catch in the throat before a vowel.
א.grammar: As a verb prefix, marks first person singular in the imperfect — I will…. One of the four letters (א ה ו י) that can stand for a vowel instead of a consonant.
א.hub_added: that it is a glottal stop rather than a vowel

ב.name: Bet, Vet
ב.definition: Second letter, value 2. The name means house, and the ancient form is a floor-plan of a house or tent. Sounds b; without the inner dot, v.
ב.sign_shows: the floor-plan of a house or tent
ב.grammar: Prefixed בְּ — in, with, by, among. One of the six begadkephat letters that soften when they lose the inner dot.

ג.name: Gimel
ג.definition: Third letter, value 3. Sounds g. The origin is contested: the name is traditionally linked to gamal, camel, while the oldest sign is read by some as a throw stick and by others as a ring stand for water jars (Egyptian W011).
ג.sign_shows: a throw stick, a camel, or a stand that holds a water jar — the three readings compete
ג.grammar: One of the six begadkephat letters. No common prefix use.
ג.hub_added: the gamal etymology, and that the three readings compete rather than agree

ד.name: Daleth
ד.definition: Fourth letter, value 4. The name means door, and the ancient form draws one. Sounds d.
ד.grammar: One of the six begadkephat letters. In Aramaic, prefixed דְּ marks the relative — which, of.

ה.name: Hey
ה.definition: Fifth letter, value 5. The ancient form shows a figure with raised arms; the name is usually glossed behold or window. Sounds h, and is often silent at the end of a word. Prefixed to a noun, it is the definite article — the.
ה.sign_shows: a figure with raised arms; a window
ה.grammar: Prefixed הַ — the, the definite article. Also the question marker, turning a statement into a question. Suffixed, the common feminine ending, and the directional toward. One of the four vowel-letters.
ה.hub_added: the definite-article prefix and the silent final h

ו.name: Vav
ו.definition: Sixth letter, value 6. The name means hook or tent peg. Prefixed to a word it is the conjunction and — the commonest use of any Hebrew letter. Also marks the vowels o and u.
ו.sign_shows: a tent peg, hook or nail
ו.grammar: Prefixed וְ — and, the commonest prefix in the Bible. Also the vav-consecutive, which flips a verb's tense in narrative — the engine of biblical storytelling. Marks the vowels o and u.
ו.hub_added: the vav-conjunctive and its vowel role

ז.name: Zayin
ז.definition: Seventh letter, value 7. The name is linked to weapon; the ancient form is a mattock or blade. Sounds z.
ז.sign_shows: a mattock or plow as readily as a sword — a tool of planting and nourishment, not only a weapon

ח.name: Chet
ח.definition: Eighth letter, value 8. The ancient form is a courtyard wall or fence. A voiceless pharyngeal fricative — the ch of Bach, made deep in the throat.
ח.sign_shows: a courtyard wall, fence or ladder

ט.name: Tet
ט.definition: Ninth letter, value 9. The ancient form is a basket or coil. Sounds t, emphatic in older Hebrew.

י.name: Yod
י.definition: Tenth letter, value 10. The name means hand or arm. The smallest letter in the alphabet. Sounds y, and marks the vowel i.
י.grammar: Prefixed, marks third person masculine in the imperfect — he will…. Suffixed ִי — my. Also forms gentilic adjectives (Israel → Israeli). One of the four vowel-letters.
י.hub_added: that it is the smallest letter

כ.name: Kaph
כ.definition: Eleventh letter, value 20; final form ך, value 500. The name means palm of the hand. Sounds k; without the inner dot, kh.
כ.grammar: Prefixed כְּ — like, as, the particle of comparison. Suffixed ךָ — your. One of the six begadkephat letters.
כ.hub_added: the final form and its value

ל.name: Lamed
ל.definition: Twelfth letter, value 30. The name is a shepherd's staff or goad, and the root l-m-d gives both to learn and to teach. The only letter that rises above the line.
ל.grammar: Prefixed לְ — to, for, belonging to. Marks the indirect object, and forms the infinitive — to write.
ל.hub_added: the l-m-d root and the ascender

מ.name: Mem
מ.definition: Thirteenth letter, value 40; final form ם, value 600. The name means water, and the ancient form is a wave. Sounds m.
מ.grammar: Prefixed מִ — from, out of. Also turns verbs into nouns: a root meaning to be holy gives miqdash, sanctuary — nouns of place and instrument. Suffixed ִים — the masculine plural.

נ.name: Nun
נ.definition: Fourteenth letter, value 50; final form ן, value 700. The name means fish in Aramaic; the ancient form is a sprout or serpent. Sounds n.
נ.sign_shows: a sprout or seed; a serpent or fish
נ.grammar: Prefixed, marks first person plural in the imperfect — we will…. Also marks the niphal, the passive and reflexive verb pattern.

ס.name: Samech
ס.definition: Fifteenth letter, value 60. The name is linked to support; the ancient form is a pillar. Sounds s.

ע.name: Ayin
ע.definition: Sixteenth letter, value 70. The name means eye. A voiced pharyngeal — silent to most English speakers, though it shapes the vowel around it.
ע.sign_shows: an eye; a well or spring

פ.name: Pey, Fe
פ.definition: Seventeenth letter, value 80; final form ף, value 800. The name means mouth. Sounds p; without the inner dot, f.
פ.grammar: One of the six begadkephat letters. No common prefix use.
פ.hub_added: the final form and the p/f alternation

צ.name: Tzaddi
צ.definition: Eighteenth letter, value 90; final form ץ, value 900. The ancient form is a harpoon or plant stalk. An emphatic s, pronounced ts.
צ.sign_shows: a harpoon, hook or plant stalk
צ.hub_added: the ts articulation and final form

ק.name: Quph
ק.definition: Nineteenth letter, value 100. The name is linked to the eye of a needle, or to the back of the head. A k made further back in the throat than kaph.
ק.sign_shows: the eye of a needle; a cord or knot

ר.name: Resh
ר.definition: Twentieth letter, value 200. The name means head, and the related root gives beginning and chief. Sounds r.

ש.name: Sin, Shin
ש.definition: Twenty-first letter, value 300. The name means tooth. With the dot at upper right it is sh; at upper left, s — the same letter, two sounds.
ש.grammar: Prefixed שֶׁ — that, which, the relative particle. Rare in early Biblical Hebrew, common in Ecclesiastes and Song of Songs, and standard in later Hebrew.

ת.name: Tav
ת.definition: Twenty-second and final letter, value 400. The name means mark or sign, and the ancient form is a cross. Sounds t.
ת.sign_shows: a cross or mark — a signature on a contract
ת.grammar: Prefixed, marks second person in the imperfect — you will… — and third person feminine. Suffixed, the feminine ending, and forms abstract nouns. One of the six begadkephat letters.
